results.question: 按月份计算已支付销售额以及累计销售额。
results.expected_sql: WITH monthly_sales AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.created_at) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, ROUND(amount, 2) AS sales_amount, ROUND(SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_sales FROM monthly_sales ORDER BY month
results.generated_sql: WITH monthly_sales AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.created_at) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS paid_sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, paid_sales, ROUND(SUM(paid_sales) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_sales FROM monthly_sales ORDER BY month;

results.question: 找出2024年已支付销量最高的商品。
results.expected_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY quantity_sold DESC, product_name LIMIT 1
results.generated_sql:
SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
  AND strftime('%Y', o.created_at) = '2024'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY total_sold DESC, p.name ASC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: 计算每种商品的目录价格与历史订单单价之间的平均差额，保留两位小数。
results.expected_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, ROUND(p.price - AVG(oi.unit_price), 2) AS avg_price_difference FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.price ORDER BY product_name
results.generated_sql:
SELECT p.name AS 商品名称, ROUND(AVG(p.price - oi.unit_price), 2) AS 平均差额
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY p.name;

results.question: 计算每个地区订单的支付成功率，保留两位小数并按成功率降序排列。
results.expected_sql: SELECT r.name AS region_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(o.id), 2) AS payment_rate FROM regions r JOIN customers c ON c.region_id = r.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY payment_rate DESC, region_name
results.generated_sql: SELECT r.name AS region_name, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS payment_success_rate FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.id GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY payment_success_rate DESC
